items.q: How often should I schedule HVAC maintenance?
items.a: We recommend annual maintenance — ideally before winter (for heating) and before summer (for cooling). Regular tune-ups keep your system running efficiently and can prevent costly breakdowns.

items.q: What's included in a heat pump cleaning service?
items.a: Our deep cleaning includes indoor and outdoor unit cleaning, coil washing, filter replacement, refrigerant check, and a full system performance test.

items.q: Do you service all brands of heat pumps?
items.a: Yes. As a Daikin Comfort Pro dealer, we focus on Daikin heat pump systems while providing professional HVAC maintenance and support.

items.q: What are the benefits of an electric boiler?
items.a: Electric boilers are highly efficient (near 100%), produce zero emissions, require less maintenance than gas boilers, and are quieter. They're an excellent choice for homes in Nova Scotia.

items.q: How long does a mini-split cleaning take?
items.a: A standard mini-split deep cleaning takes about 1-2 hours per indoor unit. We use professional equipment to ensure thorough cleaning of the heat exchanger, fan, and drain system.

items.q: Do you offer emergency repair services?
items.a: Yes, we provide emergency repair for heating and cooling systems. Contact us and we'll respond as quickly as possible.
